# Tapir commands: Revision Management Commands

The 9 commands of this group, with their parameters, results and examples. Every group and how a command is sent: [commands.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands.md).

## Revision Management Commands

### GetRevisionIssues

Retrieves all issues.

Group: Revision Management Commands. Added in Tapir 1.1.9. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetRevisionIssues

Parameters: none.

Returns:

- `revisionIssues` (array of RevisionIssue, required)
- `customScheme` (array of object): The custom scheme fields of the revision issues (key and name). Present only when the project defines any.
  - `customSchemeKey` (Guid, required)
  - `customSchemeName` (string, required)

Grasshopper: `GetRevisionIssuesComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/RevisionManagement/GetRevisionIssues.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/RevisionManagement/GetRevisionIssues.py): Lists the revision issues of the project with GetRevisionIssues.

### ModifyRevisionIssues

Modifies the ID, the short description and the custom scheme data of the given revision issues. Only the given fields are changed. Issued revision issues may refuse the change.

Group: Revision Management Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyRevisionIssues

Parameters:

- `revisionIssues` (array of object, required): The revision issues to modify. Only the given fields are changed.
  - `revisionIssueId` (RevisionIssueId, required)
  - `id` (string): The new ID of the revision issue.
  - `description` (string): The new short description of the revision issue.
  - `customSchemeData` (array of object): The custom scheme fields to set. A field is addressed by its key (as GetRevisionIssues returns it) or by its name; the fields not listed keep their values.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Grasshopper: `ModifyRevisionIssuesComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/RevisionManagement/ModifyRevisionIssues.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/RevisionManagement/ModifyRevisionIssues.py): Changes the description of the first revision issue that is not issued yet with ModifyRevisionIssues, then restores it. Needs a revision issue that is not issued.

### CreateChangeMarkers

Creates Change Markers (revision clouds) in the database of the active window, each with a cloud polygon, its marker components, the position it points to and the position of its marker head. A marker can be linked to an existing Change by its ID, or create a new Change with an ID and a description (createChange): the Archicad API creates Changes only this way. The marker head uses the Change Marker tool defaults, with the angle and always-horizontal setting given (angle, horizontalMarker). ModifyChangeMarkers takes the same settings. GetDetailsOfElements reads the markers back.

Group: Revision Management Commands. Added in Tapir 2.0.1. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateChangeMarkers

Parameters:

- `changeMarkersData` (array of object, required): The Change Markers to create, in the database of the active window (the floor plan story, a section, a detail, a worksheet or a layout).
  - `polygon` (array of Coordinate2D, required): The outline of the cloud: at least 3 points, straight edges only. A closing point that repeats the first one may be given. Needed for every marker component: a head-only marker keeps it as the area it marks, as Archicad's own example does.
  - `markerComponent` (ChangeMarkerComponent): Which parts the marker shows. A new marker gets HeadAndCloud when it is left out.
  - `changeId` (string): The ID of the Change the marker is linked to. Without createChange it must be the ID of an existing Change (GetRevisionChanges). A new marker created without it is not linked to any Change.
  - `createChange` (boolean): True: Archicad creates a new Change with changeId and changeDescription, and links the marker to it. A Change with the same ID must not exist yet. Default: false.
  - `changeDescription` (string): The description (short name) of the new Change. Only with createChange: the description of an existing Change cannot be changed.
  - `angle` (number): The rotation angle of the marker head in radians (API_ChangeMarkerType::angle), as GetDetailsOfElements returns it. A new marker gets the angle of the Change Marker tool defaults when it is left out.
  - `horizontalMarker` (boolean): Whether the marker head is always horizontal (API_ChangeMarkerType::horizontalMarker), as GetDetailsOfElements returns it. A new marker gets the setting of the Change Marker tool defaults when it is left out.
  - `position` (Coordinate2D): The point the Change Marker points to. Default: the centre of the polygon's bounding box.
  - `markerPosition` (Coordinate2D): The position of the marker head. Default: position.
  - `layerIndex` (integer): Optional layer attribute index to place the marker on. It must be an existing, unlocked layer. When omitted the marker gets the layer of the Change Marker tool defaults.

Returns:

- `elements` (ElementIdsOrErrors, required)

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/RevisionManagement/CreateChangeMarkers.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/RevisionManagement/CreateChangeMarkers.py): Clouds an area with CreateChangeMarkers, creating a new Change for it, and links a second cloud to the same Change. The markers are placed in the active window (the floor plan story, a section, a detail, a worksheet or a layout). The Change ID must not exist yet in the project.

### ModifyChangeMarkers

Changes existing Change Markers (revision clouds) with the keys CreateChangeMarkers takes and GetDetailsOfElements returns: the Change the marker is linked to (an existing Change by its ID, a new Change made with createChange, or no Change with linkType Unlinked), the marker components, the angle and always-horizontal setting of the marker head, the position of the marker head (markerPosition), and the point a marker without a cloud polygon points to (position). Only the given settings are changed. The cloud polygon cannot be changed, as Archicad keeps it: delete the marker and create it again. The marker is read back, so a value Archicad did not keep is reported as a failure.

Group: Revision Management Commands. Added in Tapir 2.0.1. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyChangeMarkers

Parameters:

- `changeMarkersWithDetails` (array of object, required): The Change Markers to change, in the database of the active window, each with the settings to change. Only the given settings are changed; the keys are those CreateChangeMarkers takes and GetDetailsOfElements returns. The cloud polygon cannot be changed: besides the settings, ACAPI_Element_Change only changes the position of a marker without a polygon, so delete the marker and create it again with CreateChangeMarkers for a new polygon.
  - `elementId` (ElementId, required)
  - `markerComponent` (ChangeMarkerComponent): Which parts the marker shows. A new marker gets HeadAndCloud when it is left out.
  - `changeId` (string): The ID of the Change the marker is linked to. Without createChange it must be the ID of an existing Change (GetRevisionChanges). A new marker created without it is not linked to any Change.
  - `createChange` (boolean): True: Archicad creates a new Change with changeId and changeDescription, and links the marker to it. A Change with the same ID must not exist yet. Default: false.
  - `changeDescription` (string): The description (short name) of the new Change. Only with createChange: the description of an existing Change cannot be changed.
  - `angle` (number): The rotation angle of the marker head in radians (API_ChangeMarkerType::angle), as GetDetailsOfElements returns it. A new marker gets the angle of the Change Marker tool defaults when it is left out.
  - `horizontalMarker` (boolean): Whether the marker head is always horizontal (API_ChangeMarkerType::horizontalMarker), as GetDetailsOfElements returns it. A new marker gets the setting of the Change Marker tool defaults when it is left out.
  - `linkType` (string ("Linked", "Unlinked")): Unlinked removes the link of the marker to its Change (the Change stays in the project); it cannot be given with changeId or createChange. Linked links the marker to the Change of changeId, which it needs; changeId alone does the same.
  - `position` (Coordinate2D): The new point the Change Marker points to. Only for a marker without a cloud polygon, the only case in which Archicad takes it (ACAPI_Element_Change); every marker CreateChangeMarkers makes has a polygon, so it is refused for those.
  - `markerPosition` (Coordinate2D): The new position of the marker head, as CreateChangeMarkers takes it. Refused for a marker without a head (markerComponent CloudOnly).

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/RevisionManagement/ModifyChangeMarkers.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/RevisionManagement/ModifyChangeMarkers.py): Clouds an area with CreateChangeMarkers, then links the marker to a second, new Change and moves and turns its head with ModifyChangeMarkers. The settings have the keys CreateChangeMarkers takes and GetDetailsOfElements returns; only the given ones are changed. The cloud polygon cannot be changed. The Change IDs must not exist yet.

## Shared schema definitions

Types that parameters and results refer to by name.

### Elements

array of ElementIdArrayItem: A list of elements.

### ElementIdArrayItem

object
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)

### ElementIdOrError

ElementIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: An element identifier or an error.

### ElementIdsOrErrors

array of ElementIdOrError: A list of element identifiers or errors.

### ElementId

object: The identifier of an element.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### Guid

string: A Globally Unique Identifier (or Universally Unique Identifier) in its string representation as defined in RFC 4122.

### Coordinate2D

object: 2D coordinate.
- `x` (number, required): X value of the coordinate.
- `y` (number, required): Y value of the coordinate.

### Error

object: The details of an error.
- `code` (integer, required): The code of the error.
- `message` (string, required): The error message.

### ErrorItem

object
- `error` (Error, required)

### SuccessfulExecutionResult

object: The result of a successful execution.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)

### FailedExecutionResult

object: The result of a failed execution.
- `success` (boolean (false), required)
- `error` (Error, required)

### ExecutionResult

SuccessfulExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of the execution.

### ExecutionResults

array of ExecutionResult: A list of execution results.

### Databases

array of DatabaseIdArrayItem: A list of Archicad databases.

### DatabaseIdArrayItem

object
- `databaseId` (DatabaseId, required)

### DatabaseId

object: The identifier of a database
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### ChangeMarkerComponent

string ("HeadOnly", "CloudOnly", "HeadAndCloud"): Which parts a Change Marker shows: only the marker head, only the cloud, or both.

### RevisionIssueId

object: The identifier of a revision issue.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### DocumentRevisionId

object: The identifier of a document revision.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### RevisionCustomSchemeData

array of RevisionCustomSchemeEntry

### RevisionCustomSchemeEntry

object
- `customSchemeKey` (Guid, required)
- `customSchemeValue` (string, required)

### DocumentRevisionReference

object: A reference to a document revision belonging to the current issue
- `revisionId` (DocumentRevisionId, required)

### DocumentRevisionReferences

array of DocumentRevisionReference: All document revisions belong to the current issue.
